name: Executor Arren
summary: Executor Arren is a high-ranking Forsaken officer stationed in Deathknell. He oversees the immediate defense and consolidation of the settlement as newly awakened undead emerge from their graves. Arren coordinates the local campaign against mindless Scourge zombies, feral beasts, and the encroaching zealots of the Scarlet Crusade.

sections.title: Commander of Deathknell
sections.body: Standing resolute just outside the chapel in Deathknell, Executor Arren serves as the primary military voice for the nascent Forsaken within their awakening grounds. While the caretakers in the crypts guide newly raised undead through their disorientation, Arren directs their focus outward toward survival. Under Queen Sylvanas Windrunner's banner, he organizes local operations to sweep away mindless zombies that threaten the village borders, establishing secure territory in the shadow of Lordaeron's fall.

sections.title: Securing the Borderlands
sections.body: Deathknell is surrounded by perils far deadlier than confused fledglings. Under Arren's orders, scouts and initiates strike at the vicious arachnids inhabiting Night Web's Hollow and eliminate dangerous predators haunting the woodland fringes. By demanding decisive action from every capable hand, Arren tests the fortitude of new arrivals, ensuring only those capable of defending their second chance at existence remain in the service of the Dark Lady.

sections.title: The Crimson Threat
sections.body: Arren's greatest strategic concern lies with the Scarlet Crusade. The zealots consider all undead to be monstrosities requiring total eradication, failing or refusing to distinguish between the Scourge and the free-willed Forsaken. Arren organizes targeted strikes against Scarlet patrols encamped in the Tirisfal wilderness, intercepting couriers and analyzing stolen dispatches to safeguard Deathknell from being purged in holy fire.

faq.answer: Executor Arren is the commanding military officer overseeing Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades. He organizes newly risen Forsaken into an effective fighting force to defend the village and secure the surrounding countryside.

faq.q: What rank is an Executor among the Forsaken?
faq.answer: Executors are trusted military and administrative commanders within the Forsaken hierarchy. They govern local garrisons, direct operations in the field, and enforce the will and law of Queen Sylvanas Windrunner.

faq.q: Why does Arren send recruits against the zombies?
faq.answer: The zombies prowling near Deathknell are mindless Scourge remnants left behind after the plague devastated Lordaeron. Arren orders them cleared so that newly awakened undead are not torn apart upon leaving the crypts.

faq.q: Why is the Scarlet Crusade in Tirisfal Glades?
faq.answer: The Scarlet Crusade is a radical human faction dedicated to exterminating all undead. They hold outposts across the ruins of Lordaeron and actively seek to purge the Forsaken, considering them identical to the Scourge.
Night Web's Hollow is a spider-infested cave north of Deathknell. Arren directs recruits to clear out the aggressive arachnids to eliminate a major local hazard and demonstrate martial competence.

faq.q: Where does Arren send recruits once they finish his tasks?
faq.answer: Once Deathknell's immediate threats are neutralized, Arren directs capable recruits outward to Brill to report to Executor Zygand and aid the broader Forsaken effort across Tirisfal Glades.

angles.text: Executor Arren is one of the first commanders every Forsaken meets upon emerging into Tirisfal, giving them their earliest taste of duty under the Dark Lady.
Arren's frontline commands in Deathknell represent the Horde's initial foothold in northern Lordaeron, securing survival amidst hostile surroundings.
